Subject: Oak & Shore — Entity setup & invoice routing

Hi Sam,

Great to meet you on the call this morning — thanks for agreeing to onboard with Redwood. To complete vendor activation and ensure invoices flow cleanly to AP, we need a short packet of information from Oak & Shore: 

1) Legal entity name (exact) and registered address
2) Tax ID / W-9 (or W-8 if outside US)
3) Primary invoice email and AP contact name/phone
4) Bank account details for ACH (bank name, account type, last 4 digits) — bank docs are fine as an attachment
5) Remittance address (if different from registered address)
6) Authorized signer name + email for contract/PO acceptance

I've attached our one-page onboarding form (Redwood_Onboarding_Form.docx) to speed things up — you can fill and return, or just reply with the items above. For POs, Redwood uses the PO prefix RW- and a four-digit vendor code (we'll assign that once set up). POs should be sent to procurement@redwood.com and invoices to accounting-invoices@redwood.com unless you tell us a different inbox.

One small ask: if you can get us a completed W-9 and a scanned copy of a bank remittance letter, we can fast-track payment terms. Let me know if Oak & Shore has any special invoicing cadence or EDI needs.

Thanks — I’ll loop in AP after we receive the documents so they can assign the vendor code and PO routing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

Hi Sam — welcome and thanks for sending the docs.

A couple quick points from AP so Oak & Shore can start receiving POs and have invoices paid without delays: 

- Vendor code: we’ll provision your vendor code as OAKS-1092 once onboarding is complete — please include that on future invoices in the vendor reference field for auto-match.
- PO format: Our POs begin with RW- then the 6-digit PO number (e.g., RW-000872). Please reference the full PO number on line 1 of the invoice.
- Invoice email: Please send invoices to accounting-invoices@redwood.com and cc accounts@oakshore.com. That mailbox is monitored by our AP team and will trigger automated matching.
- Remittance: For subscriptions vs one-time services there is no difference in routing; both go to accounting-invoices@redwood.com. If you have multiple remittance accounts, include the last 4 digits and bank name on the invoice footer.
- Terms: Net 30 is standard; exceptions require pre-approval from Finance.

Marissa — once you confirm receipt I’ll queue the vendor activation and share the vendor profile snapshot (legal name, address, tax id, vendor code) back to Sam for confirmation.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior AP Manager
Redwood Inference
